evidence.V1: Front outline is a clean even circle with 8 evenly spaced rivet bumps, centred boss; 3/4 reads as a domed round shield; top view shows rim disk + boss dome + back handle, so it reads from every angle (A15 X/Z error 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big gold rim disk, medium quartered cream/teal field and large steel boss with dark collar, small rivets ring; nothing noisy.
evidence.V3: Chunky stylised read: boss about a third of the diameter and well proud of the face (depth 1.23 of 2.7 studs), thick rim, oversized rivets; no stiff primitive look.
evidence.V4: Rim carries a consistent chamfer that catches a highlight band on both inner and outer edges, rivets and boss rounded, collar edge softened; bevels consistent across parts.
evidence.V5: No seams, z-fighting or seating faults (rivets 0.023 and handle 0.062 penetration, gap 0), but close-ups show stray faceting: visible segment steps along the rim's bevel highlight and in the flat-light outer outline, and rivets read as lumpy ~10-sided polygons; slight shading smear on the teal around the boss collar.
evidence.V6: Disciplined kit palette: gold rim accent, warm cream + teal (one hue) field, steel grey boss/rivets, ink collar; strong cream/teal value contrast; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 2400 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/ink/cream/steel palette with one hue, smooth shading and chamfered rim match the HeaterShield sibling; rivet density is a touch lower than the sibling but within kit look.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: origin at handle/hand point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic.
